name: ICF Generic Set
description: The seven categories that explain functioning best across all health conditions — the smallest common denominator for any documentation.
source: Cieza et al., ICF Research Branch / WHO

name: ICF Rehabilitation Set
description: 30 categories for describing functioning in medical rehabilitation — a suitable starting point for most adult rehab documentation.
source: Prodinger et al. 2016, ICF Research Branch

name: Brief ICF Core Set Depression
description: The core categories for describing functioning in depressive disorders, including relevant environmental factors.
source: Cieza et al. 2004, J Rehabil Med Suppl 44

name: Brief ICF Core Set Stroke
description: The 18 core categories for describing functioning after stroke.
source: Geyh et al. 2004, J Rehabil Med Suppl 44
